description.subtitle: France National Team Nike Drawstring Backpack - Navy
description.tagline: Represents France with lightness and sporty style
description.intro: The Nike Francia Academy drawstring backpack is perfect for carrying your equipment comfortably on a daily basis. Inspired by the French national team, it combines elegant design with the functionality you need for training or traveling.
key_benefits: Lightweight design: Perfect for carrying essentials without adding extra weight.
Quick access: Lace-up closure system to open and close in seconds.
Official France style: Show your passion for the national team with every use.
Daily and sports use: Ideal for training, going to the gym or moving around the city.
